editorial:
Imagine growing up by the river with your best friends, where every day is a new adventure. You will meet the Ciliwung Force, a tight group of five kids who do everything together and treat the riverbanks like their own personal playground. The vibe is very nostalgic and heartwarming, capturing that feeling of childhood innocence and the strong bonds you make when you are young. Everything seems perfect until a new girl named Sissy enters the picture, and suddenly the group dynamic shifts. You get to watch these friends struggle with jealousy and misunderstandings just as they prepare for the big getek race, which adds a lot of tension to the story.

What really makes this work is the natural chemistry between the young actors; they feel like real kids, not just actors reading a script. While the plot is simple and moves at a steady pace, the emotional moments hit home because everyone has had a fight with a friend at some point. If you are looking for a sweet family movie, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a lot of fighting and drama, the friends realize that their bond is more important than any rivalry. They put aside their differences and work together as a team for the Ciliwung getek race. In the final scenes, the group overcomes their obstacles and finishes the race, proving that friendship wins over ego. The movie wraps up with the group reunited and stronger than ever, showing that true friends always find their way back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about childhood friendship and growing up.
